title: Q-SYS-BOOT-REHEARSAL: SYS-6: bootstrap rehearsal from an empty repository to one unattended merged change
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** file:ops/bootstrap-rehearsal/latest.json
**Status:** open

Owner directive 2026-11-12: a system is an integrated collection of parts, not one worker and a database.

Prove bootstrap end to end on a fresh GitHub repo and fresh Cloudflare resources from topology and a one-paragraph idea: roles hired, queue seeded, tick and executor deployed, the executor merges one change unattended, /live-style transparency page serves. Record each stage, its failure and its fix in ops/bootstrap-rehearsal/latest.json. This is also the test for porting to another platform (PORT-EXEC-1).
Paths: seed/bootstrap/, foundation/topology.py, ops/bootstrap-rehearsal/.
Acceptance: latest.json shows every stage passed and the merged change's PR.

size: L

**Closing probe:** file:ops/bootstrap-rehearsal/latest.json exists and its tests pass.
